parameters.azimuth:
if ch("../sun_dir_spec") == "2":
        # use location and fractional day of year
        return hou.node('..').hdaModule().getSunAzimuthAndElevationDOY(
                ch("../geo_latitude"),
                ch("../geo_longitude"),
                ch("../geo_doy"))[0]

elif ch("../sun_dir_spec") == "1":
        # use location, day, and time
        return hou.node('..').hdaModule().getSunAzimuthAndElevation(
                ch("../geo_latitude"),
                ch("../geo_longitude"),
                hou.node('..').hdaModule().getDayOfYear( ch("../geo_month") + 1, ch("../geo_day") ),
                hou.node('..').hdaModule().getHourOfDay( ch("../geo_timex"), ch("../geo_hr_spec") ),
